rendered: The strains were tested across a concentration gradient (OD600 =0.02–0.2[1]). The LDA score plots split into a fully discriminated group and a partly discriminated group. Fully discriminated, with no overlapping clusters: P. aeruginosa, E. coli, E. sakazakii, L. monocytogenes, and E. faecium[2] (Fig. 3[3] panels e–h and supplementary Fig. S18a). Only partly discriminated, with partially overlapping clusters: S. typhimurium and S. aureus[4] (supplementary Fig. S18b–c). The authors also ran blind tests on several strains at unknown concentrations, and these gave 100% classification accuracy[5].
